summary.text: PORTNOR BYGG AS is a private limited company registered in Gjerdrum, founded 2013-05-14. PORTNOR BYGG AS is registered for construction and building work and public works, buying and selling of goods, resale of real estate acquired for this purpose, property and rental, and buying and selling of building materials. It was previously named BEFENOR CONSTRUCTION AS until 2019-06-14. Its main industry code is 41.000: construction of residential and non-residential buildings. In its 2025 accounts, total operating income was 53 522 384 NOK and the annual result was -4 461 734 NOK; operating income was down from 81 774 485 NOK in 2024. The annual result fell from 4 830 074 NOK in 2024 to -4 461 734 NOK in 2025. Equity fell from 17 446 747 NOK in 2024 to 12 985 013 NOK in 2025. Its verified website is portnor.no, which links to its Facebook profile. The registered employee count went from 72 on 2025-11-12 to 74 on 2026-10-13. The register's most recent update was on 2026-10-13 (antallAnsatte, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteEnhetsregisteret, registreringsdatoAntallAnsatteNAVAaregisteret).
